## Two things worth knowing

The bundled `meeting-minutes` skill was available, so I ran its `scripts/minutes.py` first — but its output contradicted the brief, so I did not ship it. Its keyword-only classifier dropped 黄雨桐's「本周五前完成复盘纪要」todo (the line contains none of the 11 keywords), misfiled 吴志远's「存在履约风险」sentence into 待办 (because it also contains 需要), and left the risk section empty. It also formatted entries as `【09:31 · 赵静怡】` where the brief mandates `【类别 · 相关人】`, filled all owners with「待定」where the brief requires real speaker names, and used「待定」rather than「未明确」for missing deadlines. I rebuilt to the brief's contract instead; the skill's `eval/runner.py` referenced in its docs isn't present in the package, so I wrote my own independent verifier.

The brief's environment note is wrong: `python-docx` is not installed on the default interpreter (`~/venvs/ml`). It is available in `~/venvs/shenbao/bin/python`, which I used to build and verify. The build script is left at `build_minutes.py`; it self-checks every entry, owner, and deadline against the transcript and exits non-zero rather than emitting anything untraceable.

One judgment call: 吴志远's sentence is both a risk and an action item. I placed it only in 风险与关注 to avoid double-counting — the whole sentence, including the「提前准备预案」action, is preserved verbatim there, so nothing is lost.
